metaDescription: What you are saving for, when you will get there, and what if.
title: Savings goals
intro: Set what you are saving for. Horizon works out when you will get there, or how much to put aside each month, and shows the sum.
leftUnknown: Upload a few months of statements and Horizon will show how much you usually have left over each month: a good guide for how much you can save.
leftUsual: You usually have about {amount} left over in a month, across your accounts (the average of {months}). Your goals can ask up to about that.
fieldNameHint: For example: Emergency fund, Goa trip, New phone.
fieldSavedHint: Leave empty if you are starting from nothing.
fieldMonthly: How much can you put aside each month?
fieldMonthlyHint: Optional. Horizon then tells you when you will get there.
fieldByHint: Optional, as month and year (for example 2027-03). Horizon then tells you how much each month.
reachedIn_one: At {monthly} a month, you get there in {month} ({count} month).
reachedIn_other: At {monthly} a month, you get there in {month} ({count} months).
neededBy_one: To get there by {by}, put aside {needed} this month.
neededBy_other: To get there by {by}, put aside {needed} a month for {count} months.
onTrack: Your monthly saving is enough for that.
notOnTrack: Your monthly saving is {short} a month short of that.
addMonthly: Add a monthly amount or a date to see when you will get there.
ifReached_one: What if: you would get there in {month} ({count} month).
ifReached_other: What if: you would get there in {month} ({count} months).
whatIfExtra: I save this much more each month
whatIfCost: A cost goes up by this much each month (rent, an EMI)
whatIfExtraNote: Each goal above shows when you would get there with the extra saving.
whatIfLeft: You would usually have about {left} left over instead of {usual}.
whatIfTooMuch: Your goals would ask for {planned} a month, more than the {left} you would usually have left. Something would have to give.
whatIfFits: Your goals would ask for {planned} a month, which fits in the {left} you would usually have left.
errTooMany: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errInvalid: Check the goal: it needs a name and an amount, money above zero, and a date that is not in the past.
errNotFound: We could not find that goal. Refresh the page and try again.
errFull: You have {max} goals, the most we keep. Delete one first.
errFailed: We could not save that. Try again in a moment.
